newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices weaken on rising stock news.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices weaken on rising stock news.

text.p: Indian sugar prices weakened on Friday as reports of the government increasing the free sale quota for October swept the markets, dealers said.

They said according to latest reports, a free sale quota of 850,000 tonnes would be pumped into the market by government next month. Earlier expectations was that this would be 800,000 tonnes. "Festival demand was also low," one dealer said.

Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 25 rupees to 1,295/1,360 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 25/29 rupees to 1,331/1,390 rupees. The markets are closed on Monday and Tuesday for local religious festivals.
